defects.detail: A closed gold pocket-watch body with its own crown/bow is held in the hand while a separate complete dial/body with a second crown/bow hangs on the chain at lower left. The two bodies later merge into one opened watch; this is object duplication, not a hinge rotation.

summary: 独立最终REJECT：240帧技术alpha/边界/残余背景筛查虽通过，但约2.5–3.75秒出现两枚独立怀表：手持一枚带顶环的封闭金色表壳，另一枚带独立顶环与完整表盘的怀表挂在左下链端；f060/f066/f078/f084/f090可见，属于道具重复与时序结构改变，不是同一怀表的正常铰链开盖，也不是抗锯齿。后段才恢复单枚开盖表并最终收回。实际完整10秒播放/idle切换已完成；本SHA不接收，不自动修补。

visual_findings.action: Watch inspection and later cover closure/stowage are visible, but the opening sequence contains two separate watch bodies linked by a chain. Final stowage does not excuse earlier duplication.
visual_findings.orientation: By f120/f144 the single open watch face is angled upward toward the character. Intermediate visible dial orientation is not itself used as a rejection reason.
visual_findings.identity_and_matte: Reviewed face/hair samples stay blue-violet/auburn, with intact headwear and shoes; no conspicuous white islands, green halo or clipped body in four-background stills.
visual_findings.additional: Black angular strips behind the turned skirt remain compatible with fabric ribbon tails in selected samples; no separate anatomy verdict is based on that ambiguity.
visual_findings.idle_switch: Completed ten seconds at640 CSS size, then switched to accepted idle. First/last sole line330; no obvious scale snap.
